annotation.title_clean: Enforcement Decree of the Intelligent Robots Development and Distribution Promotion Act
annotation.title_en: Enforcement Decree of the Intelligent Robots Development and Distribution Promotion Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Republic of Korea (Presidential Decree; Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources)
annotation.summary_en: Korean Presidential Decree implementing the Intelligent Robots Development and Distribution Promotion Act, as amended through October 2025. It sets basic and implementation plans, a Policy Council, a robot ethics advisory committee and charter, damage liability business, outdoor mobile robot safety certification and mandatory liability insurance, robotland designation, and specialized enterprise designation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources formulates basic robot plan; Policy Council deliberates
Robot ethics advisory committee (max 20, two-thirds non-governmental) advises on intelligent robot ethics charter
Damage liability business covers third-party compensation, warranty and supply contract liabilities (Art. 11-2)
Outdoor mobile robots with safety certification may display certification mark and must buy liability insurance (Arts. 24-2, 24-3)
Robotland designation, specialized enterprise standards, and administrative fine criteria
